notes.title: V1.0.3 - Fixed very persistent dog
notes.content:
In level 13, there was a dog on the desk that always spawned back in even once you've completed the level. As adorable as it was, it has now been fixed.

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
FIXED - Dog on desk no longer persistently respawns

notes.title: V1.0.2 - Fixed bone is marked as a dog in level 12
notes.content:
Hidden object 50 on level 12 (Monster River) was marked as a dog when it was in fact a bone.

If you find any other issues like this in any of my games, please let me know on the forums. Thanks!

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
FIXED - Bone incorrectly marked as dog
